title: What If the Asteroid Bennu Hit Earth?

scenes.text: What if the asteroid Bennu hit Earth? NASA's team says it could, just not for 156 years.
Bennu is about a third of a mile wide, roughly as big across as the Empire State Building is tall.
The OSIRIS-REx team puts the odds of an impact by 2182 at one in 2,700, most likely on September 24, 2182.
The energy would be about 1,200 megatons, roughly 24 times the biggest nuclear bomb ever tested.
For scale, the asteroid that ended the dinosaurs hit with the force of about ten billion atomic bombs.
And we have been there. OSIRIS-REx landed a Bennu sample in Utah on September 24, 2023, the same calendar date.
